description: I’m Imran Ali Jatoi, Full-Stack AI Architect & creator of 3D Hand Gesture Coding research app. Our project, iVision Mars, is a real-time 3D Martian Survival & Telemetry platform powered by live NASA JPL Horizons orbiters, MMGIS rovers, MOLA/SHARAD datasets, and ARES-AI (a 16-model scientific voice AI). Join us to build a winning NASA Space Apps solution! Looking for: Planetary Science researchers, Video/Pitch Editors, UI/UX Designers, and AI/Data enthusiasts.
